newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Fogade head tipped for privatization job.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Fogade head tipped for privatization job.

text.p: Esther de Margulis, president of Venezuelan Deposits Guarantee Fund, Fogade, is the most likely candidate to replace Alberto Poletto as president of privatization agency Venezuelan Investment Fund (FIV), a well- placed government source said Friday.
"The name that is being mentioned around here is Esther de Margulis," said the source, who works closely with President Rafael Caldera.
Foreign Ministry sources said earlier this week that Poletto had been put forward to become Venezuela's ambassador to Canada in September.

Esther de Margulis' experience at Fogade, where she has led a largely successful program of selling assets and reprivatizing banks inherited during Venezuela's 1994-5 financial sector crisis, made her well qualified for the FIV job, the presidential source said.
"The only problem is who will replace her at Fogade," he said.
Poletto, responding to rumors that he was to leave his job earlier this week, said that he planned to stay on until the sale of state aluminum and steel companies had been completed.
Poletto presented Congress Thursday with a model contract for the privatization of the four-company aluminum sector. Congress began studying a bill to privatize state steel company Sidor last month.
